conviction.explanation: Positive post-lease cash and realized efficiencies preserve repair upside, but statutory CFO declined, borrowings rose and RM445m cash fell short of RM821m dividends.19.31x earnings with modest normalized growth and weak price momentum leaves an unsupported income uplift.

executive_summary:
CelcomDigi has a measurable integration resource: RM141m realized savings and positive RM445m statutory cash after capex and leases. Normalized Q2 PAT grew 0.9%, qualifying the reported decline without proving rapid growth.

Dividends were RM821m, statutory CFO fell to RM1.222bn and borrowings rose to RM14.461bn. The differently defined RM2.439bn presentation cash measure cannot replace statutory CFO. Neutral balances recovery potential with current payout and cash pressure at 19.31x trailing earnings; oversold conditions confirm no reversal and future integration targets are not achieved repair.
bull_case: Further efficiencies could improve conversion and retained cash, closing the payout gap from an already cash-positive network.
bear_case: Slow integration, financing costs and continued oversized payouts could weaken cash and increase borrowing despite modest revenue growth.
key_uncertainties: Cash repair after capex and leases versus payout pace.
Delivery of integration milestones and recurring savings without double-counting.
Borrowings retain the issuer’s classification rather than an invented exclusive-debt bridge.
catalysts_upcoming: Comparable post-capex/lease cash covering dividends with stable/lower borrowings would strengthen income quality.
Observable progress against H2FY2027 IT consolidation with improved statutory conversion would support repair.
